trajectory_summary: The call never had traction: the customer disputed the lead's legitimacy in the first 30 seconds and never recovered, while the rep pushed through verify questions past cooperation instead of resolving the core disbelief. It ended in a hard DQ (renter) after a cost objection was patched with a feature line instead of inverted. Energy leaked steadily from confusion to hostility to disqualification.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: The rep did not capture any monthly bill amount or kWh from the customer; the customer asked about typical cost but did not provide their bill.

bill_document_audit.reasoning: The rep did not raise getting the utility bill or request the customer to send a bill during the call.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: Customer's stated reason ('No. I don't have money.') was acknowledged with a sympathetic aside ('I feel you there') but the rep pivoted to program mechanics rather than tying the appointment or pitch back to his money concern.

primary_coaching_focus.topic: Objection inversion missed on cost objection
primary_coaching_focus.why: This is the textbook 'I can't afford it' trigger and the rep patched it with a feature explanation twice instead of flipping it to the customer's existing bill — the single highest-leverage miss on this call.
